optimizedDescription.value: Fs filesystem ChangeRepository: Zod-validated path config, three-bucket FsChangeIndexCache, atomic mutate locks.

optimizedContext.value:
# FsChangeRepository

## Rules
- Ctor: `context: ChangeRepositoryConfig` (workspace meta, callbacks, `draftsPath`/`discardedPath`) + `config: FsChangeRepositoryConfig` (`path` only; Zod from `specd.yaml` — no runtime deps).
- Missing active/drafts/discarded dirs → `StorageDirectoryNotFoundError`.
- `createFsChangeStorageFactory()` → `ChangeStorageFactory`; `create(context, config)` forwards without merge.
- List/count/reindex → one `FsChangeIndexCache` per bucket under `{configPath}/tmp/fs-cache/{changes,drafts,discarded}/`. No direct `.specd-index.jsonl` / `.specd-index-meta.json` I/O.
- Sort: Active `createdAt` oldest→newest; Drafts `draftedAt` newest→oldest; Discarded `discardedAt` newest→oldest.
- Index writes only via `mutate(fn)`: per-bucket lock (waiters block, no contention fail); temp+rename atomic publish (meta-only; jsonl then meta; both → jsonl first). Fail mid-flight → discard temps. `list`/`count` unlocked.
- Freshness (no VCS): `isInvalidated` → rebuild; else mtime vs `sourceMtime` → rebuild; else serve. `invalidateCache()` marks all three. Rebuild: scan → stream JSONL → atomic rename + meta.
- After `save(manifest)`: upsert list row if changed. create/delete update/remove/invalidate. Moves update both buckets. `saveArtifact`/skip/non-listing history: no list update. `reindex*` → helper full rebuild.

## Constraints
- Lives `infrastructure/fs/`; MUST implement `ChangeRepository` abstract port.
